longBusinessSummary: Yamabiko Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells agricultural machinery in Japan, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through Outdoor Power Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, and General Industrial Machinery segments. The company manufactures, sells, and rents handheld forestry and landscape maintenance machinery, such as chain saws for limbing, felling, and pruning trees; trimmers and brush cutters for grass cutting, mowing, and clearing; and power blowers for blowing, collecting, and shredding leaves and debris; provides boom sprayers for large-scale farm and crop operations; speed sprayers for fruit trees; mounted equipment for cropland pest control management, such as labor-saving pest control equipment for paddy fields, and soy and potato harvesters; generators, welding machines, lighting equipment, and high-pressure washers. Further, it manufactures and sells agricultural drainage pipe burying machinery; contract logistics; and manufactures and sells prototype parts for automobiles. It serves forests and agricultural fields, construction sites, parks, and homes under the Kioritz, Shindaiwa, and ECHO brand names. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Ome, Japan.
